metadata.description: Visit every active Major League Baseball home stadium across the United States and Canada.
metadata.author: Journey

journey.name: MLB Stadiums
journey.description: Visit all 30 active Major League Baseball home stadiums across the United States and Canada, from historic Fenway Park and Wrigley Field to waterfront favorites, retractable-roof venues, and the Athletics' temporary home in West Sacramento.

items.name: American Family Field
items.description: Home of the Milwaukee Brewers, this ballpark is known for its fan-shaped retractable roof, lively tailgating culture, and Bernie Brewer's home-run slide.

items.name: Angel Stadium
items.description: Home of the Los Angeles Angels, this Anaheim ballpark is recognized by its prominent halo landmark and the rock-and-water feature beyond left-center field.

items.name: Busch Stadium
items.description: Home of the St. Louis Cardinals, this downtown ballpark frames memorable views of the city skyline and the Gateway Arch beyond the outfield.

items.name: Chase Field
items.description: Home of the Arizona Diamondbacks, this downtown Phoenix ballpark features a retractable roof and a swimming pool beyond the right-center-field wall.

items.name: Citi Field
items.description: Home of the New York Mets, this Queens ballpark combines red-brick architecture with tributes to New York baseball history and the celebrated Home Run Apple.

items.name: Citizens Bank Park
items.description: Home of the Philadelphia Phillies, this South Philadelphia ballpark features skyline views and a giant illuminated Liberty Bell that celebrates home runs and victories.

items.name: Comerica Park
items.description: Home of the Detroit Tigers, this downtown ballpark combines baseball with fountains, tiger sculptures, a carousel, and expansive views of the city.

items.name: Coors Field
items.description: Home of the Colorado Rockies, this red-brick downtown ballpark is famous for its high elevation, mountain views, and hitter-friendly atmosphere.

items.name: Daikin Park
items.description: Home of the Houston Astros, this retractable-roof ballpark incorporates historic Union Station and features a locomotive that travels above left field after home runs.

items.name: Dodger Stadium
items.description: Home of the Los Angeles Dodgers, this hillside stadium combines mid-century design, palm-lined views, and one of baseball's most recognizable settings.

items.name: Fenway Park
items.description: Home of the Boston Red Sox since 1912, this intimate historic ballpark is defined by the Green Monster, Pesky's Pole, and its distinctive asymmetrical dimensions.

items.name: Globe Life Field
items.description: Home of the Texas Rangers, this Arlington ballpark pairs a retractable roof with modern amenities and climate-controlled baseball in North Texas.

items.name: Great American Ball Park
items.description: Home of the Cincinnati Reds, this riverfront ballpark features Ohio River views and steamboat-inspired power stacks that erupt after home runs.

items.name: Kauffman Stadium
items.description: Home of the Kansas City Royals, this baseball-only stadium is celebrated for its signature outfield fountains, crown-shaped scoreboard, and spacious setting.

items.name: loanDepot park
items.description: Home of the Miami Marlins, this retractable-roof ballpark offers climate-controlled baseball and a colorful Miami-inspired design near Little Havana.

items.name: Nationals Park
items.description: Home of the Washington Nationals, this modern riverfront ballpark sits near the Anacostia River and within sight of the U.S. Capitol area.

items.name: Oracle Park
items.description: Home of the San Francisco Giants, this waterfront ballpark is renowned for views of San Francisco Bay and home runs splashing into McCovey Cove.

items.name: Oriole Park at Camden Yards
items.description: Home of the Baltimore Orioles, this influential retro-classic ballpark incorporates the historic B&O Warehouse and sits near Baltimore's Inner Harbor.

items.name: Petco Park
items.description: Home of the San Diego Padres, this downtown ballpark blends city views, nearby parks, and the historic Western Metal Supply Company building.

items.name: PNC Park
items.description: Home of the Pittsburgh Pirates, this intimate riverfront ballpark is prized for its views of downtown Pittsburgh and the Roberto Clemente Bridge.

items.name: Progressive Field
items.description: Home of the Cleveland Guardians, this downtown ballpark combines distinctive light towers, an active neighborhood setting, and views toward the city skyline.

items.name: Rate Field
items.description: Home of the Chicago White Sox, this South Side ballpark features a pinwheel-topped scoreboard, wide concourses, and views toward downtown Chicago.

items.name: Sutter Health Park
items.description: Temporary home of the Athletics from 2025 through 2027, this West Sacramento ballpark also hosts the Triple-A Sacramento River Cats.

items.name: T-Mobile Park
items.description: Home of the Seattle Mariners, this waterfront ballpark uses a retractable roof as a weather canopy while preserving an open-air baseball atmosphere.

items.name: Target Field
items.description: Home of the Minnesota Twins, this open-air downtown ballpark features local limestone, city views, and convenient access to Minneapolis transit.

items.name: Tropicana Field
items.description: Home of the Tampa Bay Rays, this domed ballpark in St. Petersburg is known for its indoor setting, overhead catwalks, and rays touch tank.

items.name: Truist Park
items.description: Home of the Atlanta Braves, this modern ballpark is integrated with The Battery Atlanta, a surrounding district of restaurants, shops, and entertainment.

items.name: Wrigley Field
items.description: Home of the Chicago Cubs, this historic neighborhood ballpark is celebrated for its ivy-covered outfield walls, hand-operated scoreboard, and rooftop views.

items.name: Yankee Stadium
items.description: Home of the New York Yankees, this Bronx ballpark evokes the franchise's historic home through its limestone exterior, rooftop frieze, and Monument Park.

items.name: Rogers Centre
items.description: Home of the Toronto Blue Jays, this downtown Toronto ballpark features a retractable roof and a landmark setting beside the CN Tower.
